==Overview==
The '''Unnamed Sector''' will be the 4th section you will encounter within the game. The entrance to this section can spawn in section [[Section A| A (A-100+)]], [[Section D| D (Derelict only)]] and [[Section M| M (Maintenance Tunnels Only)]] after both a 1 in 90 and a 1 in [Number of rare rooms in the section] are rolled successfully. Your objective in the '''Unnamed Sector''' is to find the '''Strange Keycard''', which will start spawning after the first [[False-200]] attack. Collecting the '''Strange Keycard''' will cause [[Red Rooms]] to start a few rooms later, where you'll need find the first exit door which can spawn randomly (this exit door is guaranteed to spawn 100 doors after [[Red Rooms]] starts). This will not be the end however, as [[Mouth|False-300]] will appear from behind you after you get near the end of the long hallway that is past the first exit door and will chase you forward until you reach the second and final exit door, one that leads to an elevator that goes back to the [[Section A]] lobby.

You have escaped the '''Unnamed Sector''', awarding you the [https://www.roblox.com/badges/4497939033694098/The-Beginning-of-The-End "The Beginning of The End."] badge. You will now spawn with the '''Strange Keycard''' in your inventory every run, which will allow you to access [[Section E]].

* The Unnamed Sector had a demo that lasted 50 rooms, and [[Mori]], [[False Witness]],  and [[Tackle]] were the only threats
